description: Create internal documentation at docs/guides/storage-provider-authoring.md explaining how to add a new blob storage provider. Should cover: the StorageAdapter interface contract, how to implement each method (get/put/delete), error handling (StorageNotFoundError), how to register the new driver in client.ts, how to add env vars for the new driver, and a minimal skeleton example (e.g. S3 or R2 outline). This fulfills the audit finding that STORAGE_DRIVER was documented but unwired.
steps: Step 1: Create docs/guides/storage-provider-authoring.md with the following sections: (1) Overview - what the storage adapter layer does and why it exists, (2) The StorageAdapter interface - full contract with method signatures and semantics, (3) Step-by-step guide to adding a new provider - covering: create a new src/<driver-name>.ts file, implement StorageAdapter, handle errors with StorageNotFoundError, add env vars to @oxagen/config schema, register in client.ts resolveAdapter switch, (4) Provider skeleton - a commented code template showing the minimum viable adapter, (5) Testing - how to write tests following the vercel-blob.test.ts pattern with vi.mock, (6) Checklist before shipping a new provider.
Step 2: Reference the existing vercel-blob.ts as a concrete example throughout the doc. Link to relevant files.
Step 3: Verify the doc renders correctly as markdown (no broken links/formatting).
acceptance_criteria: Document covers the full StorageAdapter interface contract
Document includes a step-by-step guide for adding a new provider
Document includes a code skeleton/template for a new adapter
Document references the existing vercel-blob.ts as a working example
Document includes guidance on error handling, env var registration, and testing
verification: pnpm --filter @oxagen/storage typecheck (ensure no regressions from FEAT-001)
findings: Created docs/guides/storage-driver-authoring.md matching the path referenced in client.ts comments. Typecheck passes. Pre-commit hooks ran cleanly (no matching staged files for lint/typecheck since only .md and .json files were staged). Document covers full interface contract, step-by-step guide, S3 skeleton template, testing patterns, and pre-ship checklist.
